answer: Like an ocean whose tides demand immense gravity, our network grounds consensus in recursive cryptographic staking. Rather than letting phantom identities freely wander across the digital horizon, every validator node must bind physical compute proofs to a dynamic web-of-trust matrix. Mimicking natural crystallization, synthesizing valid consensus requires superlinear attacker cost: forging n identities scales slashing risk and capital lockups by O(n²), starving rogue clusters before they can disturb the deep ocean currents.
